title: Shadow a small decision model without giving it control
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He loads Agentic Recipe `decision_plane` with `shadow_mode` and divergent production vs shadow fixture answers. He performs `run_recipe` and verifies production still controls while both outcomes are recorded and disagree. [^rc-dp-shadow]
implementation: Agentic Recipe `decision_plane` via `ShadowAskRunner` / `compare_shadow_decision` semantics. Product CLI verb `run_recipe` with `DecisionPlaneRecipeAdapter`.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `shadow_compare.yaml` drives `run_recipe`; hard expects on production_action / agreement keys.
